title: Witold Henisz (Wharton Vice Dean, Impact/Sustainable Business) reflects on Eric's Aspen Summit presentation
summary: Witold Henisz — Vice Dean of the Wharton Impact, Value and Sustainable Business Initiative — reflects on Eric's Aspen Summit presentation, affirming the need for governance structures that protect purpose while raising a critical academic question: whether the simple solutions on offer are sufficient for the challenges at hand.
blockquote: I also reflect on the presentation of Eric Ries's Incorruptible, affirming the need for governance structures that protect purpose while questioning whether such simple solutions are sufficient for the challenges at hand.
attribution_title: Vice Dean, Wharton Impact, Value and Sustainable Business Initiative
